opportunities.title: Herbert West's Reagent, Statted as a 5e Ritual (and Why It's Worse Than Animate Dead)
opportunities.why_now: Paizo just licensed Re-Animator for 13 Omens, putting reanimation horror back in the ttrpg conversation.
opportunities.angle: 60-sec mechanical breakdown: homebrew the reagent as a risky ritual spell, compare action economy and corpse-quality rules to Animate Dead/Revivify, deliver the 'why your DM should say no' ruling.

opportunities.title: The Lament Configuration Is Just a Cursed Deck of Many Things With Extra Steps
opportunities.why_now: Hellraiser's TTRPG was just announced from The One Ring's designer, giving horror-curse mechanics a news hook.
opportunities.angle: Dry comparison bit: rule a Lament-Configuration-style cursed item in 5e/Shadowdark, covering save DCs, summoning cenobites as a CR-appropriate encounter, and the 'no take-backs' clause GMs always forget to enforce.

opportunities.title: This D&D x WoW Species's Racial Trait Breaks Action Economy on Day One
opportunities.why_now: All 16 species for D&D World of Warcraft just got revealed, giving a fresh crunch target before the book even ships.
opportunities.angle: Pick the most broken-looking racial ability from the reveal, run the math on an exploit, give the one-sentence table ruling to nerf it.

opportunities.title: Death Saves Are a Lie: Why DCC's Funnel Kills Better Than 5e Ever Will
opportunities.why_now: Gnome Stew's piece on death-as-a-system is fresh discourse this week and lines up perfectly with cross-system rules content.
opportunities.angle: Side-by-side mechanical teardown: 5e death saves vs Shadowdark's severe/fatal table vs DCC's funnel lethality, ending on the veteran-GM verdict for which actually teaches players stakes.

opportunities.title: D&D Beyond's New Search Still Can't Find the One Broken Advantage Stack
opportunities.why_now: D&D Beyond just shipped its long-awaited search overhaul, making it a timely hook to expose a rules gap the tool won't catch.
opportunities.angle: Short screen-recorded bit: try to search for an advantage-stacking combo (e.g., Reckless Attack + Pack Tactics + Faerie Fire), show the tool missing the interaction, deliver the actual ruling verbally.
